title: Blow-up (L. Simon) estimate on the unit ball: [Dw]_{alpha;B_1/2} <= delta K + C_delta (S + G)
statement: Let n >= 1 and l be natural numbers, 0 < alpha < 1, lam > 0, M real and delta > 0. Let L := L(R^n, R^l) and B_1 := B_1(0). There is a constant C_delta >= 0 with the following property. Let a : R^n -> (continuous bilinear forms on L), Phi : R^n -> (continuous linear forms on L), w : R^n -> R^l and reals K, S, G with G >= 0 satisfy, for all x, y in B_1 and P, Q in L: lam ||P||^2 <= a(x)[P][P]; |a(x)[P][Q]| <= M ||P|| ||Q||; |a(x)[P][Q] - a(y)[P][Q]| <= M |x - y|^alpha ||P|| ||Q||; |Phi(x)[P] - Phi(y)[P]| <= G |x - y|^alpha ||P||; |w(x)| <= S. Assume moreover that w is C^1 on B_1, that ||Dw(x) - Dw(y)|| <= K |x - y|^alpha for x, y in B_1, and that the integral over B_1 of a(x)[Dw(x)][Dzeta(x)] equals the integral over B_1 of Phi(x)[Dzeta(x)] for every C^1 compactly supported zeta : R^n -> R^l with tsupport zeta in B_1. Then ||Dw(x) - Dw(y)|| <= (delta K + C_delta (S + G)) |x - y|^alpha for all x, y in B_{1/2}(0).
lean_statement: ∀ n ℓ : ℕ, 1 ≤ n → ∀ α : ℝ, 0 < α → α < 1 → ∀ lam M δ : ℝ, 0 < lam → 0 < δ → ∃ Cδ : ℝ, 0 ≤ Cδ ∧ ∀ (a : Rn n → (Rn n →L[ℝ] Rn ℓ) →L[ℝ] (Rn n →L[ℝ] Rn ℓ) →L[ℝ] ℝ) (Φ : Rn n → (Rn n →L[ℝ] Rn ℓ) →L[ℝ] ℝ) (w : Rn n → Rn ℓ) (K S G : ℝ), 0 ≤ G → (∀ x ∈ ball (0 : Rn n) 1, ∀ P : Rn n →L[ℝ] Rn ℓ, lam * ‖P‖ ^ 2 ≤ a x P P) → (∀ x ∈ ball (0 : Rn n) 1, ∀ P Q : Rn n →L[ℝ] Rn ℓ, |a x P Q| ≤ M * ‖P‖ * ‖Q‖) → (∀ x ∈ ball (0 : Rn n) 1, ∀ y ∈ ball (0 : Rn n) 1, ∀ P Q : Rn n →L[ℝ] Rn ℓ, |a x P Q - a y P Q| ≤ M * ‖x - y‖ ^ α * ‖P‖ * ‖Q‖) → (∀ x ∈ ball (0 : Rn n) 1, ∀ y ∈ ball (0 : Rn n) 1, ∀ P : Rn n →L[ℝ] Rn ℓ, |Φ x P - Φ y P| ≤ G * ‖x - y‖ ^ α * ‖P‖) → (∀ x ∈ ball (0 : Rn n) 1, ‖w x‖ ≤ S) → ContDiffOn ℝ 1 w (ball (0 : Rn n) 1) → (∀ x ∈ ball (0 : Rn n) 1, ∀ y ∈ ball (0 : Rn n) 1, ‖fderiv ℝ w x - fderiv ℝ w y‖ ≤ K * ‖x - y‖ ^ α) → (∀ ζ : Rn n → Rn ℓ, ContDiff ℝ 1 ζ → HasCompactSupport ζ → tsupport ζ ⊆ ball (0 : Rn n) 1 → ∫ x in ball (0 : Rn n) 1, a x (fderiv ℝ w x) (fderiv ℝ ζ x) = ∫ x in ball (0 : Rn n) 1, Φ x (fderiv ℝ ζ x)) → ∀ x ∈ ball (0 : Rn n) (1 / 2), ∀ y ∈ ball (0 : Rn n) (1 / 2), ‖fderiv ℝ w x - fderiv ℝ w y‖ ≤ (δ * K + Cδ * (S + G)) * ‖x - y‖ ^ α
